question: Can sparse randomized restrictions escape large cancellation traps while retaining exact coefficient construction and a fixed information/capacity budget?
hypothesis: Before WSP43's deletion search, repeatedly query random half-subsets of a contradictory witness, keeping only subsets preserving its selected output residual. This should find smaller exact-interrogation subcubes at64/128-bit widths without writing false coefficients. Thirtytwo-term and low-budget failures may persist.
world: Same hidden whole vector map generator as WSP43 but disjoint seed tag; no exposed source matrices, supports, family or seeds.
algorithm: Exactly WSP43 direct algorithm with one pre-minimization phase: while witness has>8 bits, sample independent Bernoulli.5 subsets of its set bits using existing fixed2333+width policy RNG. Keep subset only if selected lowest differing output bit remains residual1. Reset consecutive-failure counter on shrink; at32 consecutive failures or128 total trials for that witness stop restriction and fall back to frozen repeated-deletion search. Every source response uses the same cache and source budget. Existing degree8/full-subset transform,capacity and update limits unchanged. No source data or compute increase.
control: Copied frozen WSP43 direct acquisition with same width/query ceiling/capacity/policy seed, called baseline. Both see genuine independently selected probes under same maximum ceilings, not identical observations; actual used queries and baseline test exposure counted. Independent fitted GF2 feature regression on direct transcript and discovered vocabulary; basis-only/zero. Algebraic regression is not a matched strongest neural baseline and supplies no discovery evidence.
capacity_per_action: width+33 vector features, no growth of ceiling
source_budget: min(ceiling,2**width-32) per action. Pre-screen if width+1 basis replies exceed that budget.

tests.exact_structure: hidden evaluator-only coefficient equality and complete maps; zero false direct coefficients required
tests.retention: separately acquired second world with counted queries/cost, first model byte equality
tests.negative: all128-probe screens, halving failures, subset stops, ambiguous/unresolved maps and low-budget effects preserved

thresholds.engineering: all previous full tests and new focused tests, clean source/G29 on Windows/Linux; identical integer primary scores/trace
thresholds.invariant: zero false direct nonzero coefficients across all executed episodes; wrong writes INVALID
thresholds.bounded_gain: on width64/128,eight_nonlinear,1024-ceiling cells:heldout>=.95,composition/plans>=.90,exact action-map fraction>=.90,and heldout gain versus WSP43 control>=10pp. Report every other family/width/budget without selection.
thresholds.scientific: DEV_SUPPORTED only for preset gain, MIXED on exact invariant with partial gains/missed thresholds, NEGATIVE if no useful recovery. No independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS/general intelligence/unknown primitive invention/neural training replacement.

authority: Isolated external contributor synthetic draft; no merge/main/accepted refs, protected first-use, official loop, private runner, controller, scheduler, paid API, integration, deployment or live actions.
limits: All discovery machinery is supplied Python; state bits, action identity and AND/XOR algebra are not invented by the agent.
Extra cached trials are real compute, extra source queries consume the unchanged ceiling.
Exact coefficient proof and broad synthetic success do not establish general intelligence or general superiority to training.
